message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" dated "2-8 FEBRUARI 2015" features four men in suits against a textured gray background. The men are depicted from the chest up, arranged horizontally. From left to right: a man with glasses looking slightly left, a man with glasses and arms crossed looking forward, a man with a mustache looking forward, and a man in a white suit looking forward with a shadow over his face.

Red laser-like lines crisscross the foreground and background, with several small red dots appearing on the men's foreheads and cheeks, as well as on their clothing. The man on the far left has a red dot on his cheek, the central-left man has one on his forehead, the central-right man has one on his forehead, and the man on the far right has one on his eye area.

The text at the top reads "JOKOWI: KEPUTUSAN ADA PADA SAYA." Below the large "TEMPO" masthead, it says "SKENARIO MEMBIDIK KPK." A smaller paragraph below reads: "Ada temali di antara para penggugat pemimpin Komisi. Abraham Samad akan dijerat perkara pemalsuan dokumen." The bottom left includes pricing "RP 39.500" and a barcode.
